description: Create a new AgentDomains account and get an API key. Requires no existing key. IMPORTANT: the returned api_key is shown ONCE and is never retrievable again — you must store it immediately (save it to ~/.agentdomains/config.json or set AGENTDOMAINS_API_KEY) or the account is lost. The account is provisional: attach and confirm an email within 30 days (see the attach_email tool) or it is deleted along with its domains. This endpoint is rate-limited per IP address.
name: signup
